'''Abar''', with his brother [[Balat]], is a sword-swallower and fire-eater in [[Valan Luca]]'s [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|Traveling Show]].{{ref/book|11|8}}{{ref/book|11|11}}

==Appearance==
Abar is a lean man.

==Activities==
After [[Egeanin Tamarath]] and [[Bayle Domon]] get married, [[Matrim Cauthon]] buys a tent from Abar and Balat.{{ref/book|11|8}} Later, he is performing as Mat, [[Thomdril Merrilin]], [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]], and [[Selucia]] walk to [[Maderin]].{{ref/book|11|11}}
